LESSON: GOOD BEHAVIOUR DURING MEALTIMES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.5: Good behaviour during mealtimes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Good behaviour during mealtimes, part of Foods in Grade 1 HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: why it is important to mealtimes?
